<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FindResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FarmingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_UpdateApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecoverBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyUpdatedList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateBot" name="Decide to create a farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FindResources" name="Choose resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start bot farming"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Farm the selected resources in parallel, with up to 10 resources collected at once, using the configured priorities and dependencies.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Disaster" name="Natural disaster" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">natural_disaster_occurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecoverBot" name="Recover bot from setback"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farming_milestone_reached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notification sent"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateList" name="Player updates resource list" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_UpdateList">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">player_requests_resource_list_update</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update resource list"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" name="Apply updated resource list"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateApplied" name="Updated list applied"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose whether to brag and/or send materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingChoice" name="Choose sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Join sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FarmingComplete" name="Farming and sharing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_FindResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_FindResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">brag_to_selected_friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">send_materials_to_selected_friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="End_FarmingComplete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_01" sourceRef="Boundary_Disaster" targetRef="Task_RecoverBot"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_02" sourceRef="Task_RecoverBot" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_01" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_02" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_01" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_02" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_03" sourceRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" targetRef="End_UpdateApplied"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PlayerAndBot" name="Player and Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FarmingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateBot" name="Begin creating a farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource and tool dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start bot farming"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Collect selected resources in parallel, up to 10 at a time, prioritizing more urgently needed resources and following the configured dependency logic. Some resources may be needed to create tools required to gather other resources.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Farming">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolPrerequisite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherToolResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Farming" name="Begin farming"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite" name="Are tools needed for selected resources?"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherToolResources" name="Gather resources needed to create tools"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateTools" name="Create required tools"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin" name="Continue farming"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Farming" name="Bot finished farming"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_01" sourceRef="Start_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_Tools" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite" targetRef="Task_GatherToolResources">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">configured_dependencies_require_tools</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_NoTools" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite" targetRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not_configured_dependencies_require_tools</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_02" sourceRef="Task_GatherToolResources" targetRef="Task_CreateTools"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateTools" targetRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_05" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="End_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster setback" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Disaster">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_DisasterBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_Disaster">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">natural_disaster_occurs</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply disaster setback to bot"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Disaster" name="Disaster setback applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_01" sourceRef="Start_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_02" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="End_Disaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify player of milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Milestone">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MilestoneBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Milestone" name="Farming milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farming_milestone_reached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Milestone" name="Milestone notification sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_01" sourceRef="Start_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_02" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update resource list during farming" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdatePlayer" name="Player">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdateBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyUpdatedList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateList" name="Player requests resource list update" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">player_requests_resource_list_update</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of resources to farm"/>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" name="Apply updated resource list"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateList" name="Updated resource list applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_01" sourceRef="Start_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_02" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_03" sourceRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" targetRef="End_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose whether to brag and/or send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingChoice" name="Choose sharing actions" default="Flow_Sharing_None"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Join selected sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FarmingComplete" name="Farming and sharing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_01" sourceRef="Start_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_02" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_03" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_04" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_05" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_06" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_07" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">brag_to_selected_friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_Send" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">send_materials_to_selected_friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_None" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_BragJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_SendJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_End" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="End_FarmingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FarmingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateBot" name="Begin creating a farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource and tool dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start bot farming"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Farming">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolPrerequisite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherToolResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Farming" name="Begin farming"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite" name="Are tools required by the configured dependencies?" default="Flow_Farm_NoTools"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherToolResources" name="Gather resources required to create tools"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateTools" name="Create required tools"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin" name="Continue farming"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
        <bpmn:documentation>Collect selected resources in parallel, up to 10 at a time, prioritizing resources according to their configured urgency and following the configured resource and tool dependencies.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Farming" name="Bot finished farming"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_01" sourceRef="Start_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_Tools" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite" targetRef="Task_GatherToolResources">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">configured_dependencies_require_tools</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_NoTools" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisite" targetRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_02" sourceRef="Task_GatherToolResources" targetRef="Task_CreateTools"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateTools" targetRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolPrerequisiteJoin" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_05" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="End_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster setback" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Disaster">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_DisasterBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_Disaster">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">natural_disaster_occurs</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback to bot"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Disaster" name="Disaster setback applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_01" sourceRef="Start_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_02" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="End_Disaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify player of farming milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Milestone">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MilestoneBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Milestone" name="Farming milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farming_milestone_reached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Milestone" name="Milestone notification sent"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_01" sourceRef="Start_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_02" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update resource list during farming" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdatePlayer" name="Player">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdateBot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyUpdatedList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateList" name="Player requests resource list update" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">player_requests_resource_list_update</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of resources to farm"/>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" name="Apply updated resource list"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateList" name="Updated resource list applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_01" sourceRef="Start_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_02" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_03" sourceRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" targetRef="End_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectSharing" name="Select friends and sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingChoice" name="Choose sharing actions" default="Flow_Sharing_None"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Join selected sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FarmingComplete" name="Farming and sharing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_01" sourceRef="Start_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_02" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_03" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_04" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_05" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_06" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_SelectSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">brag_to_selected_friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_Send" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">send_materials_to_selected_friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_None" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_BragJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_SendJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_End" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="End_FarmingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant must identify or choose inputs that will guide later work.: Model that human selection as a user task before the work that uses those inputs.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant must identify or choose inputs that will guide later work.

rules.instruction: When the description states an action or decision represented by a BPMN element, including any applicable scope or criteria: Label the element with concise wording that faithfully reflects the stated action or decision and preserves any applicable scope or criteria, without implying unsupported meaning or broader applicability.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or decision and gives details that distinguish its action, scope, or criteria

rules.instruction: When the description mentions an external person or organization as the recipient of a request, the source of a response or payment, or the destination of a referral, but does not describe that party’s own process or responsibilities: model the stated work and events within the modeled participant; do not create separate participant pools or message flows solely because of that mention
rules.situation: the description names external people or organizations as recipients of an action or item but does not describe their own process or responsibilities

rules.instruction: When the description states that a prerequisite may need to be completed before other work can proceed: Model a gateway at the point where the prerequisite is assessed, with branches for completing the prerequisite and proceeding without it when it is not needed.
rules.situation: the description states that a prerequisite may need to be completed before other work can proceed

rules.instruction: When the description assigns activities in one end-to-end process to both a human and an automated system: Model their responsibilities in separate lanes of the same process; use separate participant pools only when the description presents them as independent communicating participants.
rules.situation: the description assigns activities in one end-to-end process to both a human and an automated system

rules.instruction: When the description states that one activity, event, or event outcome leads to another, including after a wait or along an alternative event path: Model sequence flows connecting the corresponding BPMN nodes in the described order, preserving transitions into and out of waiting events and each described alternative path.
rules.situation: the description states that an activity, event, or decision outcome leads to another activity, event, or choice point, including after a setback or at a completion point

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes related actions, events, or outcomes that could otherwise be confused: Label each BPMN element so the stated distinctions remain clear; do not substitute a related action or use a generic label that could refer to multiple described actions or outcomes.
rules.situation: the description names an activity and distinguishes it from a related action or outcome
